declaration.preface: Excel Industries Ltd. is committed to integrating Sustainability principles across our supply chain to minimize environmental impacts, ensure responsible social practices, and contribute to ethical business operations. This policy outlines our expectations from suppliers like quality, quantity, cost, timely delivery, logistics and legal compliance with our core sustainability values, ensuring that our procurement practices align with our values and contribute to a sustainable future for the Organization.
declaration.declaration:
Excel Industries Limited, a responsible manufacturer of industrial chemicals, intermediates, specialty chemicals, agrochemical intermediates, and pharmaceutical products, is committed to promoting sustainable procurement practices that foster responsible sourcing, ethical business conduct, and social responsibility throughout our supply chain.

It is the Company’s endeavor to:

Integrate sustainability principles into all procurement and supply chain decisions.

Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and international sustainability standards.

Source responsibly by engaging with suppliers who uphold ethical, environmental, and social performance standards.

Promote fair and transparent procurement processes that prevent corruption, bribery, and anti-competitive practices.

Encourage suppliers to voluntarily, adopt cleaner technologies, renewable energy, waste reduction, and circular economy practices.

Assess and monitor supplier performance through sustainability audits, feedback, and capacity-building initiatives.

Foster long-term partnerships with suppliers who share our vision of sustainability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Provide training and guidance to procurement teams and suppliers to enhance awareness of sustainable procurement principles.

Continually review objectives and set measurable targets to improve our sustainable procurement performance.

Engage stakeholders and customers transparently on our supply chain sustainability performance and progress.

This Sustainable Procurement Policy serves as a guiding framework for responsible sourcing and supplier engagement at Excel Industries Limited, ensuring that sustainability is embedded across our entire value chain.

The policy will be reviewed in every six months in MRM for its adequacy and continuing relevance to the organization’s business. It will be made available to all employees, suppliers, customers, and other stakeholders wherever required.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all activities related to the manufacture, scale-up and supply of industrial chemicals, agrochemical intermediates, specialty chemicals, polymer intermediates, and pharmaceutical products. It also applies to all business units and functions within Excel Industries Limited, including procurement, manufacturing, research and development, logistics and corporate offices. It applies to all workmen working for the company including our own employees, contractors and their workmen working inside the premises, all stakeholders and external providers associated with the company. This policy is applicable across all operating sites of Excel Industries Limited as listed below:

focusAreas: Commitment to Health, Safety, and Sustainability

Supplier Environmental Practices: Supplier Environmental Practices: We require suppliers to adopt environmentally responsible practices, including but not limited to,
Energy & GHGs: Suppliers should voluntarily adopt energy-efficient processes and reduce greenhouse gas emissions through renewable energy, energy conservation, and emission control strategies.

Materials & Waste: Efficient use of raw materials is essential. Suppliers must minimize waste generation, encourage recycling and reusing materials, and responsibly manage hazardous and non-hazardous waste.
Water Usage: Suppliers should actively monitor and reduce water consumption, ensuring that wastewater is treated and discharged according to environmental regulations.
Air Pollution: Processes must be designed to minimize emissions and ensure compliance with local air quality standards.
Chemicals Management: Suppliers are expected to safely handle, store, and dispose of chemicals in compliance with local and international safety and environmental guidelines.
Biodiversity: Suppliers should avoid sourcing from environmentally sensitive areas and protect ecosystems by promoting biodiversity conservation.
Supplier Social Practices: Supplier Social Practices: Excel Industries Ltd. prioritizes fair labor practices and human rights across the supply chain. We expect suppliers to comply with,
Health & Safety: Maintain safe working conditions by following occupational health and safety regulations, ensuring the well-being of all employees involved in production and supply processes.
Working Conditions: Adhere to fair labor practices, ensuring workers' rights to fair wages, reasonable working hours, and non-discriminatory work environments.
Child Labor & Forced Labor: Suppliers must comply with laws prohibiting child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking.
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Excel Industries expects suppliers to foster inclusive work environments that promote diversity and equal opportunity.
Career Management & Training: Suppliers are encouraged to offer training and career development opportunities to improve employee skills and job satisfaction.
Supplier Ethics & Governance: Supplier Ethics & Governance: Suppliers are required to maintain ethical business conduct by,
Corruption Prevention: Implementing anti-corruption measures to prevent bribery and unethical business dealings.
Responsible Information Management: Ensuring the protection of confidential data, intellectual property, and sensitive business information throughout the supply chain.

Suppliers who demonstrate leadership in health and safety, environmental responsibility, and social sustainability.
Comply with local, national, and international regulations related to health, safety, and environmental protection.
Implement continuous improvement strategies for Sustainability.

targets.target: Ensure 100% of strategic suppliers sign and comply with Excel’s Supplier Code of Conduct by 2034-35.
Conduct annual supplier ESG self-assessments covering 100% of Tier-1 suppliers by 2034-35.
Conduct on-site ESG audits for 100% of our high-risk suppliers every year, effective by 2034-35.
Ensure 100% of procurement employees and key suppliers receive ESG training annually by 2034-35.
Achieve zero incidents of major supplier non-compliance with sustainability or ethical requirements by 2034-35.
Energy & GHGs: Reduce total supply chain Scope 3 GHG emissions by 15% by 2034-35 compared to 2021 baseline.
Water: Achieve 10% reduction in supplier water consumption and ensure 100% wastewater treatment compliance by 2034-35.
Waste: Reduce waste generation by 10% and achieve 20% recycling/reuse rate across supplier operations by 2034-35.
Materials: Ensure 25% of raw material procurement comes from sustainable or recycled sources by 2034-35.
Air Emissions: Ensure 100% of key suppliers comply with local and national air quality regulations by 2034-35.
Ensure 100% supplier compliance with fair labor, human rights, and non-discrimination laws by 2034-35.
Maintain zero (0) incidents of child labor or forced labor in the supply chain by 2034-35.
Ensure 100% of supplier workplaces provide safe and healthy working conditions by 2034-35.
Increase female participation in supplier workforce by 10% across key supplier facilities by 2034-35.
Achieve zero (0) incidents of corruption, bribery, or anti-competitive practices across the supply chain by 2034-35.
Conduct due-diligence assessments for 100% of new suppliers before onboarding by 2034-35.
Maintain 100% data protection compliance among all suppliers handling confidential or sensitive information by 2034-35.
Integrate ethical performance metrics into supplier evaluation and renewal processes by 2034-35.

Development and implementation of Procurement strategies.

Responsible for monthly review of the Policy at all sites to assess progress and make necessary amendments as required. Evaluates Procurement performance metrics and KPIs. Ensures cross-functional coordination on Procurement initiatives.
Responsible for the day-to-day management of supplier relationships, ensuring adherence to the Sustainable Procurement Policy, and integrating sustainability criteria into procurement processes.
Responsible for integrating SPP and practices within their units.

policy.monitoring:
Excel Industries will regularly assess supplier performance through visits, audits, reviews, and other suitable feedback mechanisms.

Suppliers will be evaluated on their ability to meet or exceed environmental, social, and ethical standards.

Non-compliances will be reviewed accordingly; it may result in corrective actions or termination of business relationships.

Performance Monitoring: Set measurable Sustainable Procurement performance goals and regularly review progress towards achieving these goals.

Transparency: Report our Sustainable Procurement performance and progress in a transparent manner to stakeholders.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The policy will be reviewed in every six months in MRM for its adequacy and continuing relevance to the organization’s business.

Monthly Review: The Policy will be reviewed monthly at all the sites during Management Review Meeting (MRM) committee to assess progress and make necessary amendments, if required.

SCM department will be evaluated through assessment towards completion of qualitative objectives and quantitative targets and identifying areas for improvement in supplier environmental and social practices.

Performance Reporting: Regular reporting on environmental performance to the MRM Committee happens on a six monthly basis. The Board of Directors and stakeholders review environmental performance reporting through the Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report (BRSR) and Annual Sustainability Report (ASR) on a yearly basis.

Stakeholder Engagement: Continuous dialogue with stakeholders to incorporate feedback and improve our Sustainable Procurement practices.

Non-compliance may result in corrective actions or termination of business relationships.

This policy will be reviewed Monthly to ensure its continued suitability to the organization’s business objectives and evolving sustainability standards.
